info.title: GDPR Data-Subject Requests
info.description: Generic, jurisdiction-neutral GDPR / AVG data-subject-request register. Captures access (art-15), rectification (art-16), erasure (art-17), restriction (art-18), portability (art-20), and objection (art-21) requests, with the EU art-12 legal deadline and a status lifecycle. Consuming apps (e.g. pipelinq) project locale-specific overlays (BSN/BRP, AP complaint reference, FG/DPO, citizen correspondence) on top of this generic model.

x-openregister.description: Foundational GDPR data-subject-rights register shipped by OpenRegister for fleet-wide reuse.

data-subject-requests.title: Data-Subject Requests
data-subject-requests.description: Generic GDPR / AVG data-subject-request register (art-15/16/17/18/20/21) with the EU art-12 legal deadline and a status lifecycle.

dataSubjectRequest.title: Data-Subject Request
dataSubjectRequest.summary: A single GDPR / AVG data-subject-rights request.
dataSubjectRequest.description: Jurisdiction-neutral model for a data-subject-rights request: who the subject is, which right is exercised, the request's status in its lifecycle, and the EU art-12(3) legal deadline (one month from receipt, extendable once by two months).

startVerifying.description: Begin verifying the requester's identity / eligibility.

startProgress.description: Begin fulfilling the request (discovery, export, rectify, erase).

fulfil.description: Mark the request fulfilled (the right was honoured).

refuse.description: Refuse the request (a lawful exemption applies).

close.description: Close the request without a fulfil/refuse outcome (e.g. withdrawn).

subjectId.description: Identifier of the data subject (e.g. email or another identifier value indexed in the PII index).
subjectId.title: Subject Identifier

subjectType.description: Optional type hint for the subject identifier (e.g. 'email', 'phone'). Maps to a GdprEntity type when discovering data.
subjectType.title: Subject Type

status.description: Lifecycle state of the request (governed by x-openregister-lifecycle).
status.title: Status

receivedAt.description: When the request was received. Anchors the EU art-12 legal deadline.
receivedAt.title: Received At

dueAt.description: EU art-12(3) base legal deadline: receivedAt + 1 month.
dueAt.title: Legal Due Date

extendedUntil.description: Extended legal deadline when a single +2-month extension was granted (art-12(3)). Empty when not extended.
extendedUntil.title: Extended Deadline

extensionReason.description: Justification recorded when the deadline was extended.
extensionReason.title: Extension Reason

outcome.description: Generic outcome summary once the request reaches a final state.
outcome.title: Outcome

notes.description: Free-text handler notes (generic; no jurisdiction policy).
notes.title: Handler Notes
